growth_boundary: New private campaign content plus positive guest free-space decrease; includes retained failed namespaces. No deletion.
scope: Matched normalized core only: B0 direct Arrow, B2 Spark batch, B3 queued Kafka Structured Streaming availableNow. This does not measure raw parsing or full production domain finalization.

selections.rpki: September 1 canonical membership full six-field projection; source-coordinate map/provenance retained as shared reference, not newly streamed raw source observations
selections.ris: Complete first five-minute accepted EventRow projection, five exclusions retained as shared source evidence
selections.dns: First 4096 independently normalized raw source rows; partial artifact, no complete daily group claim

input_binding: normalized-input-binding.json and source-manifest-validation.json; each prepared wrapper also binds full source-normalized SHA256
projection: Every full typed normalized row canonically JSON serialized with sorted keys and no NaN, paired with existing source logical ID; lossless representation shared across all three engines
comparison: Exact SQLite identity-to-full-JSON membership comparison, identical retry reconciliation only; ordered canonical checksum after exact membership, never checksum-only acceptance
trial_order: All 27 configuration/repetition pairs shuffled once, seed 42

timing.preparation: Shared wrapper/SQLite construction separately measured once; original source parsing excluded from every mode
timing.core: Read prepared normalized input, write same projection in Snappy Parquet; Spark includes S3A publication in write action, so cannot isolate pure transformation from publication
timing.all_in: Fresh worker process launch through validated conditional MinIO completion and Spark shutdown; startup, producer, physical checksums and exact independent readback included
timing.B3: Publish bounded acknowledged chunks before starting isolated availableNow query; queued historical replay, not paced live arrival and not H3 1x experiment

layout: Two writer partitions; 262144 maximum target rows/file; Arrow row groups <=65536, Spark block layout runtime default. Record actual files, do not rank representation efficiency from unmatched row-group layouts.
kafka: Fresh UUID topic per B3 trial, two partitions, replication one, zstd producer compression, 128 rows/chunk, <=1MiB/chunk, <=32MiB buffer, acknowledgments required
publication: Existing conditional commit primitive, dedicated phase20-matched/UUID prefix; files checked exactly before batch commit; full identity coverage checked before completion metadata
resources: VM 2CPU/6GiB/64GiB unchanged; Spark local[2], driver 2GiB; Arrow CPU/IO pools 2; >=20GiB host/guest free, >=512MiB guest available, <=12GiB process tree, single measured job
estimate: 7200-second total cap and 3GiB aggregate retained growth are hard stops, not guaranteed completion; current normalized source inputs ~98MiB plus bounded DNS subset before JSON wrapping
stop: Any exactness, delivery, OOM, missing object or budget failure stops campaign; no automatic retry or timeout increase; retain all evidence
unapproved: Full-hour replay, RIS rates matrix, VM changes, downloads, old evidence deletion, full production E3 matrix
